title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Game Without Being Owned by It
caption:
Gaming isn't the enemy. A free man can pick up a controller and put it down again. The problem is when he can't, when "one more match" quietly owns every night he has.

Set the stop before you start. Turn the guys in your lobby into real brothers. Notice what you're hiding from. And give God the first hour, not the leftovers.

Send this to the brother you play with every night.

#faith #godlyman #gaming #selfcontrol #christianmen
